explanation: In many Hindu communities, Monday (Somavara) is associated with Shiva. Customs vary by region and tradition.
In many communities, especially in North India, Tuesday is associated with Hanuman; elsewhere it may be associated with Devi or Murugan.
In some communities, Wednesday is associated with Ganesha. Customs vary by region.
In many communities, Thursday (Guruvara) is associated with Vishnu and with honoring one's teachers. Customs vary by region.
In many communities, Friday is associated with Devi — often Lakshmi or Durga. Customs vary by region.
In many communities, Saturday is associated with Hanuman and with Shani. Customs vary by region.
